city.name: Zagreb
city.differential: Six labs, one loop: Zagreb turns its textile and plastic waste into public products, from school workwear to street furniture.
city.description: Fab City Zagreb connects the city's fab labs, university workshops and manufacturers into one production ecosystem. The current focus: textile circularity, distributed plastic recycling and open environmental data, coordinated from Fablab Zagreb with the City's Office for Economy.

ecosystem.name: Fablab Zagreb
ecosystem.summary: Digital fabrication lab at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering; runs the city's open machine park and the Fab Academy node.

ecosystem.name: Radiona
ecosystem.summary: Makerspace and DIY-culture association running electronics, new-media art and the monthly repair café since 2011.

ecosystem.name: ZICER
ecosystem.summary: Zagreb Innovation Centre at the Zagreb Fair; hosts hardware startups and the city's prototyping fund.

ecosystem.name: REGEA
ecosystem.summary: North-West Croatia Regional Energy Agency; pilots building retrofits and solar co-ownership with the city.

ecosystem.name: FER, University of Zagreb
ecosystem.summary: Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing; builds the open sensor platform behind the air-quality network.

ecosystem.name: Zelena akcija
ecosystem.summary: Friends of the Earth Croatia; runs the reuse depot and drafted the city's zero-waste plan.

ecosystem.name: City of Zagreb — Office for Economy
ecosystem.summary: Co-funds the Textile Loop and opens public buildings to Fab City pilots.

projects.title: Zagreb Textile Loop
projects.summary: Collection points in Trešnjevka and Dubrava feed a sorting studio where local designers remake post-consumer textiles into workwear and school gear. 4.2 tonnes processed since January.

projects.title: Precious Plastic Zagreb
projects.summary: A distributed network of shredders and sheet presses turns collected HDPE into benches and planters, now installed on two pilot squares.

projects.title: Open Air Zagreb
projects.summary: 42 open-hardware sensors publish street-level air data; residents solder their own units at monthly Radiona workshops.

projects.title: School Fab Labs
projects.summary: Mobile fabrication kits rotate through five primary schools; the first cohort of 60 teachers is trained and teaching repair and digital making.

news.title: Textile Loop opens its second collection point in Dubrava
news.summary: Drop-offs now come from two districts; sorting capacity doubles to 800 kg a week.

news.title: Recycled-plastic benches installed on two squares
news.summary: Precious Plastic Zagreb delivered twelve benches and planters pressed from city-collected HDPE.

news.title: Sixty teachers finish the School Fab Labs training
news.summary: All five pilot schools now run weekly repair and digital-making classes.

news.title: Zagreb publishes its first local-production snapshot
news.summary: Six months of data from the textile and plastic loops, now feeding the network dashboard on fab.city.

news.title: Open Air Zagreb passes 40 live sensors
news.summary: Street-level air data is now dense enough to compare all city districts.
